answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable work bond before trading: the bond is earned only by completing verified tasks, so a fresh identity starts on a ledge with no credit. Each Sybil must separately earn its bond, and misbehavior burns it. Like a relic held in escrow, the bond gains value with honest history, while a ripple of attestations from counterparties confirms it. An attacker pays the full bond plus labor per fake, with no bulk discount.
